title: Edge count forcing a triangle
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph on $n$ vertices with $m$ edges. If $n^2 < 4m$, then $G$ contains a triangle, that is, three mutually adjacent vertices.
replaced:
\emph{If \texttt{G} is simple and \texttt{$\varepsilon$ > $\nu$$^{2}$/4}, then
\texttt{G} contains a
triangle.}

\textbf{7.3.3}  $(a)$  Show that if $G$ is simple and $\varepsilon > \nu^2/4$, then
$G$ contains a triangle.
